raw.rationale: Hydrocortisone-valerate is a glucocorticoid receptor agonist with cytostatic rather than broadly cytotoxic activity, and PRISM profiling of glucocorticoids typically shows only modest lineage-selective effects, most plausibly in lymphoid/hematologic lineages not listed here; among the listed lineages, glucocorticoid receptor expression and anti-proliferative responses are strongest in breast and some CNS/skin contexts, but selective killing at 2.5 µM for 5 days is unlikely to exceed baseline rates.
